title: Ninja ZX-10R KRT (Rally Edition)
description: The Kawasaki Ninja ZX-10R KRT (Rally Edition) delivers razor-sharp chassis feedback for riders hunting apexes for riders demanding purposeful real-world performance. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Focused on closed-course control and sporting precision, its Aggressive Forward Tuck posture pairs with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort to optimize high-speed aerodynamic stability.
